Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1a) and CT (Figure 2) demonstrate an ill-defined area of consolidation in the left lower lobe without associated hilar or mediastinal lymphadenopathy, a pattern characteristic of Bronchiolitis Obliterans Organizing Pneumonia (BOOP), particularly when unresponsive to antibiotics. Options suggesting malignancy, sarcoidosis, or bronchiectasis are inconsistent with the lack of lymphadenopathy and the specific morphology of the opacity shown.
